subject: Social Media
title: Cambridge Analytica
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cambridge Analytica usable.

hook.text: A personality quiz on Facebook harvested data from 87 million users. They never took the quiz themselves.

buildup.text: Cambridge Analytica used that data to build voter profiles. Each person got tailored political ads on Facebook.

discovery.text: The firm worked on the 2016 Trump campaign and the Brexit referendum. Micro-targeting at unprecedented scale.

twist.text: Scholars still debate whether it actually worked. The data was messy. The targeting was crude. The hype was huge.

climax.text: What mattered wasn't the result—it was the revelation. People learned their data was a political weapon.

punchline.text: Your likes told them how to persuade you.

quiz.question: How did Cambridge Analytica obtain data from 87 million Facebook users?
options: Through a personality quiz app and friend data
